JD(U) Opposes Ganga Treaty Renewal Citing Bihar's Interests

The Janata Dal (United) party has opposed the renewal of the Ganga water-sharing treaty with Bangladesh. The party cited the interests of Bihar as the primary reason for its opposition. This stance was reported by multiple outlets, highlighting the party's concerns regarding water availability and its impact on the state.
